audio_track_actual: Avicii, 'The Nights' — music bed only; the whisper transcript is garbled song lyrics, not speech. No spoken narration in the reel.
video_overlay_text_observed: Slideshow of fifteen burned-in title cards over stock or archival images, bookended by the poster's own vacation footage. Opening card 'Stop Trusting The Official Narratives'; closing cards 'They Know When Your A Threat To "Their Society"' and an ebook promo, 'THE RABBIT HOLE — THE TRUTH BENEATH. 100 chapters. 10 categories. Everything they don't want you to know.' The fifteen: Joe Felz (free energy data); Stanley Meyer (water-powered car); Oliver Tree (Antarctica and the ice wall documentary); Nikola Tesla (free energy); Charlie Kirk (denying $150 million to support Israel); Avicii (elite child trafficking); Paul Walker (sex trafficking ring); Princess Diana (wrote that she thought they would stage a car crash); Gary Webb (CIA and Iran-Contra); Michael Jackson (before he would own his record label); Danny Casolaro (the secret cabal); JFK (before designating AIPAC a foreign agent); Don Bolles (government organized crime); Jan Kuciak (government corruption 'in Slovenia'); George Hahn (the cure to cancer).
audio_content_summary: No spoken content. The reel is a fifteen-name slideshow set to music, each card asserting that a named person died shortly before releasing or exposing something, ending with a sales pitch for a 100-chapter ebook.
implied_frame: The frame is a single pattern — people who were about to reveal something died first — assembled from fifteen cases of very different evidentiary quality and sold as a product. Taken one at a time the cases separate cleanly. Four are documented killings or deaths where the person's work is a matter of record and the case is unresolved or unresolved at the top: Don Bolles, killed by a car bomb in 1976; Jan Kuciak, shot with his fiancee Martina Kusnirova in 2018 in Slovakia, not Slovenia, with the alleged organizer acquitted twice; Danny Casolaro; and Gary Webb, whose 'Dark Alliance' ran eight years before his death, not shortly before. Two are documented statements or documents rather than deaths-before-disclosure: Diana's October 1995 note to her solicitor saying she expected a staged car crash, which exists as a police exhibit, and the Justice Department's November 1962 order that the American Zionist Council register under FARA, abandoned after Kennedy's assassination. Several are real deaths with a motive attached that has no trace: Paul Walker, killed at 80 to 93 mph in a 45 zone with no mechanical defect found; Avicii; Oliver Tree, killed with five others in a mid-air helicopter collision over Rio on June 14, 2026, whose Antarctica footage was a satirical album companion filmed on a seven-day charter; and Michael Jackson, who owned a publishing catalog rather than a record label. Two collapse on inspection: Stanley Meyer's water-powered car was found by an Ohio court in 1996 to be ordinary electrolysis and a 'gross and egregious fraud' two years before he died, and George Hahn was a Stanford radiation biologist who published his hyperthermia work openly and died at 98 in 2024, the 'cure' framing being a tabloid distortion he spent his life correcting. Joe Felz's 2026 death was ruled suicide by the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the 72-hour claim traces to social posts his partner disputed. Tesla and Charlie Kirk are covered by existing records. The closing frames sell an ebook, which is the reel's purpose.
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
